title: feat: refill Pollinations automation balances internally
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restore the Pollinations automation account to 100 Quest Pollen or 20 Paid Pollen whenever the respective balance reaches 10 or less.
- Record each refill as an internal credit in the existing rewards ledger; concurrent checks cannot issue duplicate grants.
- Leave regular users and Stripe auto top-up unchanged. There is no monthly allowance cap.
- Verified with the Gen billing tests and Gen/Enter typechecks. The PR's full CI checks will rerun for this commit.

gist.headline: A self-watering automation account
gist.blurb: The automation account gets its own watering can: low balances refill through the rewards ledger, without changing anyone else’s top-ups.
gist.summary: The Pollinations automation account refills to 100 Quest Pollen or 20 Paid Pollen when the respective balance reaches 10 or less, recording each grant in the rewards ledger and preventing duplicate grants from concurrent checks.
gist.impact: Automation can keep running through low balances without a monthly refill cap; regular users and Stripe auto top-up remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the automation account as a small code-plant tended by Polli beside a retro terminal. Two lime-green gauges labeled Quest and Paid show the separate balances; a ledger book represents recorded refills. The scene should feel like quiet maintenance, not a new user-facing reward.
